subject: The dementia paradox: why excess weight correlates with lower mortality
script: From Agewell Brief: The dementia paradox: why excess weight correlates with lower mortality. A sweeping 24-year longitudinal cohort analysis reveals an unexpected survival advantage in overweight and obese individuals diagnosed with dementia. In biological systems facing systemic crisis, energy reserves dictate survival. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
